name: Campingplatz Hager
beschreibung: The campsite Hager is located in Langkampfen in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley, only a few kilometres from the fortress town of Kufstein. The surrounding mountain landscape of the Kaisergebirge and the Brandenberger Alpen shapes the close-to-nature surroundings. The facilities include modern sanitary installations, spacious pitches with electricity connection and a common room. A bread roll service and a parlour serving regional cuisine complete the range of services. The site impresses with its quiet, well-kept atmosphere. Active holidaymakers can reach a dense network of hiking and cycling trails directly from the site. The campsite also caters to families with its playground and spacious sunbathing lawn.
